resolvedFindings.finding: Method freeze accepted any listed files without mandatory implementation membership.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Exact mandatory 23-file roster now enforced before new data access; synthetic omission rejection passed.

checks: Only new 900 IDs, three generation arms and seeds 25–49 are accepted; original 300 remain separate.
Source ranks are authenticated/replayed unchanged; exact coordinate, arm, seed, producer status and outcome membership joins are required.
Whole scientific tie blocks receive exact rational first-choice/top-five expected weights; missing selected labels are not dropped.
Equal biological-group then equal target weights preserve the paired AGTR1 group rather than counting it twice.
Generation failures remain in planned-attempt yield denominators; missing generated outcomes block arm selection.
Prespecified pair-only 0.02 gain/no acceptable-first loss/unchanged coverage gate uses exact arithmetic; dimer/helix/CASR cannot drive pair arm choice.
Paired bootstrap resamples whole biological groups with fixed PCG64 seed and preserves explicit missingness.
CLI requires explicit parent analysis release, exact frozen method roster, final non-snapshot source preparation, authenticated outcome receipt and bound recorded timing.
limitations: End-to-end execution with actual new900 labels was not run and remains gated by parent release.
Bootstrap intervals are descriptive on a small development group panel, not evidence of general superiority.
